title: armorfix
description: a exp bottle that fixes the armor
body:
a plugin for paper/bukkit 1.21.4 that creates a exp bottle with /getbottle command that can fixes the armor from any durability lower then max to max durabilityhas configurable evry message dosent say anything at start of message like [ARMORFIX]your armor was fixed cooldown is customiseble too to have a cooldown in a message you must to put %s to display it to use press your use button like normal exp bottle has permission message cannot be used by command block(maybe) can be given not to  just yourself but to other player with /getbottle <nickname> the armorfix item can be copied thru creative and it can still work
